name: note_on_two_lines_reads_back_the_same
why: REPORT 8CD843 N29, round 8 (27/10/2026). A general note of four lines, sent with «\n» between them, came back from SOLIDWORKS with «\r\n»: «text_matches» false, the step succeeded, and the compact answer said «none is a warning» and left out the text read back. A false «different» for the line ends, and a real difference would have passed the same way, in silence.
defect_caught: A note whose text read back is called different only because SOLIDWORKS ends its lines with «\r\n». The case sends two lines and asks that the comparison says they match: the line ends are not the text.

expect.why: a view attaches to the path of the part
the bench follows the new document (entry GT0)

arguments.text:
BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES
DEBURR ALL HOLES

expect.why: THE MEASURE OF THE THING: the two lines read back are the two lines sent, whatever ends them. On bridge 0.150.1 this was false
both lines are in the text SOLIDWORKS reads back, not only the first

arguments.text:
BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES
DEBURR ALL HOLES

expect.why: THE SAME TEXT FINDS IT: the note is looked for with the line ends left aside, as «note» compares it. Found while writing the replay of round 8: an exact comparison would answer that no note of the sheet has this text
one note fewer, counted on the sheet and in the views
